name: Civil unrest
summary: Mass protests with clashes in France, Germany and Portugal on 31 Oct–1 Nov
state: Hundreds of thousands protested across France on 31 Oct, a third weekend, with clashes in several cities (Japan Times). Protests in Germany turned violent on 1 Nov as activists clashed with police (Bloomberg), and Portuguese police arrested 13 at a housing protest on 1 Nov (France 24). No deaths have been reported.
for_you: If you are travelling to France, expect transport disruption on protest days and avoid demonstrations. Check FCDO travel advice for France.
rubric_hit: Significant protests in several countries = Watch; no deadly unrest

sources.title: The Japan Times — Clashes break out as hundreds of thousands protest in France
Bloomberg — German protests turn violent as activists clash with police
France 24 — Portuguese police clash with housing protesters, arrest 13

why: Mass protest and state crackdowns signal political fragility and can topple governments.
drivers: Cost of living, elections, corruption, repression, food and fuel prices.

rubric.alert: Deadly nationwide unrest or a state crackdown in a major country.
rubric.watch: Significant protests in several countries or deadly unrest in one.
rubric.normal: No deadly mass unrest in large countries.
